book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn LUK

content: Peidek duwen Manaman en Sises

Rahn ehu, nindokon Sises eh ketin wiewia sapwellime padahk ong aramas akan nan Tehnpas Sarawio oh ketin kapakapahrengki Rongamwahu, samworo lapalap oh sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo kei, iangahki kaunen mehn Suhs kei, ahpw pwarodo
oh patohwanohng, “Komw mahsanihong kiht mahs, ia pwungen omwi ketin wiewia soahng pwukat? Ihs me ketikihong komwi manaman en wia mepwukat?”
Sises ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “I men kalelapak rehmwail mahs mehkot. Kumwail sapeng ie mahs.
Ia duwen en Sohn Sounpapidais eh manaman en pepidais, e tepisang Koht de aramas?”
Irail ahpw tapihada mengimengloalki, ma kitail pahn nda, ‘E tepisang Koht,’ e pahn mahsanihong kitail, ‘A dahme kumwail sohte pwosonki Sohn?’
A ma kitail pahn nda, ‘E tepisang aramas,’ pokon wet pahn koasuk kitail, pwe irail kin wiahki Sohn soukohp men.”
Irail eri sapeng Sises, patohwan, “Se sohte patohwan wasa e tepisang ie.”
Sises eri mahsanihong irail, “Eri, I sohte pahn ndaiong kumwail ni manaman en ihs me I wiewiahki mepwukat.”
Karasaras en Soumwet kei nan Mwetin Wain
Sises eri mahsanihong pokono karasaras pwoatet: “Ohl emen koadoakihada mwetin wain ehu; e ahpw kihong soumwet kei re en kohwahkihong. E ahpw seiloakla sang ni imwe mihmihki liki ahnsou reirei.
Ni eh lel ahnsoun dolung wahn mwetin waino, e ahpw kadaralahng soumwet ko eh ladu men pwe en ale rehrail pwaise sang ni eh mwahto. Soumwet ko uhdahte wokiseli laduwo oh kapwurehla kahiep.
E pil pwurehng kadarala emen eh ladu ko; a soumwet ko pil pwurehng kemeseli, re ahpw kasarowehdi oh pil kapwurehla kahiep.
Ohlo pil song kadarala kesilimenen eh ladu. Soumwet ko pil kemehte oh keseieisang nan mwetin waino.
Eri, ohl me ahneki mwahto ahpw mengimengloalki, ‘Dahme I pahn wia? I pahn kadarala nei pwutak kompoake; re uhdahn pahn wauneki!’
A ni soumwet ko ar kilangada pwutako, re ahpw ndapene nanpwungarail, ‘Ih nein ohlo pwutako met. Kitail kemehla, pwe kitail en uhd ahnekihla mwetin wainet.’
Irail eri sikeneisang nan mwahto oh kemehla.” Sises ahpw ketin keinemwe, “Eri, dahme mwohnsapw en mwetin waino pahn wiahiong soumwet ko?
E pahn pein piserla pwe en kemehla soumwet pwuko, oh ketikihong ekei soumwet mwetin waino.” Ni aramas ako ar rong mepwukat, re ahpw nda, “Met sohte kak wiawi!”
Sises ahpw ketin mahmahsanih irail oh mahsanih, “A ia wehwehn mahsen en Pwuhk Sarawi wet:

content.text: ‘Takai me sounkou ihmw ko kesepwekelahr pwehki eh soh katepe

content: Eri, mehmen me pahn pwupwudiong pohn takaio pahn ohla; a mehmen me takaio pahn pwupwudiong powe, e pahn kamwutepene.”
Peidek duwen Ketikihda Daksis
Sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo ko oh samworo lapalap ako song en salihedi Sises wasao, pwehki re ese me e ketin karasaraskin irail; ahpw re masak aramas ako.
Iei me re mwasamwasahnkihte ahnsou mwahu. Irail eri kadaralahng Sises lipoahrok kei, ni mwomwen aramas mwahu, pwe re en lidipihedi ni eh mahsen kan oh pangalahng pahn manaman en kepina.

Irail pwukat eri kalelapak rehn Sises, patohwan, “Maing Sounpadahk, se patohwan ese me omwi mahsen kan oh padahk kan me inenen pwung, pwe komw sohte kin kupwurohki mwomwen aramas, pwe kupwur en Kohtohte ong aramas me komw kin ketin kupwurohki kawehwehda.
Eri, ia duwen kupwuromwien ong irair en daksis? Me pwungiong atail Kosonnedo de soh, atail kin kihda daksis ong Sihsar?”
Sises mwahngih ar widing, e ahpw mahsanihong irail,
“Kumwail kasalehiong ie mahs ehu mwohni silperen. Sansal en ihs oh mwaren ihs me ntinting powe?” A re sapeng, patohwan, “Sihsar.”
Sises eri mahsanihong irail, “Eri, kumwail kihong Sihsar dahme en Sihsar, a ong Koht dahme sapwellimen Koht.”
Eri, irail sohte kak kasapwunge ni mehkot mwohn pokono, re ahpw nennenlahte oh medemedewe sapwellime pasapeng kapwuriamwei wet.
Peidek duwen Iasada sang Mehla
Sadusi kei ahpw pwarodo rehn Sises. (Irail pwukat iei soangen aramas ko me kin nda me dene me melahr akan sohte pahn mourda sang mehla.) Irail eri idek rehn Sises, patohwan,
“Maing Sounpadahk, Moses koasoanediong kiht kosonned wet: Ma ohl emen mehsang eh pwoud sohte neira seri, eri, rien ohlo me pahn pwoudikihda liohdio pwe ira en kapwaiong rie me melahro nah seri.’
Eri, pwihn pirien ehu mie, ohl isimen. Me laud rehrailo pwoudikihda lih emen, ahpw mehsang, sohte wiahda seri.
“Me keriemeno ahpw pwoudikihda liohdio;
me kesilimeno pil wiahda duwehte. Eri, ih duwen irail me isimeno koaros, re mehsang ar pwoudo, sohte neirail seri.
Ni imwilah, liho pil mehla.
Eri, ni rahn me me melahr kan pahn mourda, ihs me pahn en liho eh pwoud? Pwe irail me isimeno koaros pwoudikihda.”
Sises ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Ohl oh lih akan en sampah wet kin pwopwoud,
a ohl oh lih akan me warohng mourda sang mehla oh mourki mouren mwehi me pahn kohdo, re sohte kin pwopwoud.
Pwe re duwelahr tohnleng kan, oh re solahr kak mehla. Irail me sapwellimen Koht, pwehki ar mourdahsangehr mehla.
Moses pil kadehdeier ni mehlel duwen me melahr akan ar pahn mourda. Pwe ni koasoiepen kisin tuhke tekatek me mpwumpwulo, Moses kahdaneki Kaun-o ‘Koht en Eipraam, Koht en Aisek, Koht en Seikop.’
Met wehwehki duwen eh wia Koht en me momour kan, a kaidehk Koht en me melahr akan—pwe aramas koaros kin momouriong ih.”
Ekei sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo ko ahpw patohwanohng Sises, “Maing Sounpadahk, me pwung omwi mahsenen!”
Irail eri sohla men idek rehn Sises mehkot.
Peidek duwen Mesaia
Sises ketin mahsanihong irail, “Ia duwen amwail kak nda me Mesaia sapwellimen Depit?
Pwe pein Depit mahsanih nan Pwuken Melkahka kan:

content.text: I lao wiahkihda omwi imwintihti kan utupen aluweluwomwi kan.’

content: Eri, ma Depit wiahki eh ‘Kaun,’ a ia duwen Mesaia eh kak nein Depit?”
Sises Kalikedi Tohnpadahk ko sang Sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo ko
Ni aramas koaros ar rongorong, Sises ahpw mahsanihong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko,

“Kumwail kalekeikumwailsang sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo kan me kin mwahuki mi nan likou reirei ahpw moamoahlseli mwohn aramas akan, oh kin men aramas akan en rahnmwahwih ihr nan pokon akan; me kin pilada dewerail lempahntamw nan sinakoke kan oh kin mwahuki moangehda tehpel kan ni kamadipw kan;
me kin adihasang liohdi kan ar mehkoaros, ahpw kin liliosohski wia kapakap reirei! Arail kadeik uhdahn pahn laud mehlel!”
